title: Every Tool Interactive Job Migration
description: Phase 8 of the Interactivity-First Refactor: migrate every remaining interactive tool and framework command from direct event callbacks/run-to-completion work to InteractiveJob factories and progress/preview/commit streams. Classify the complete Phase 0 command inventory as migrated, batch-only pending rewrite, forbidden from UI, or deleted; enforce release rejection of unclassified commands; migrate imports/exports, serialization, compression, selection expansion, snapping, boolean geometry, routing, animation baking, search, diffing, and package operations; verify zero unmigrated interactive callbacks reachable from UI.
